task.description:
Implement DSL-02 (AST stability) per the design artefact at src/design/dsl-02-ast-stability.md.

DSL-02: The parser MUST produce an AST whose shape is deterministic for a given input. Two parses of the same input MUST yield structurally identical ASTs.

Implementation steps:
1. Read src/design/dsl-02-ast-stability.md for the exact design.
2. Add pub fn nodeEql(a: *const Node, b: *const Node) bool to src/expr/ast.zig (at the end, below the Ast struct).
3. The function must cover ALL 14 Node variants with an exhaustive switch (no else branch).
4. Add a test block in src/expr/ast.zig (or a suitable test file) that:
   a. Parses the same expression string twice.
   b. Asserts nodeEql(parse1.root, parse2.root) == true.
   c. Parses two different expressions and asserts nodeEql returns false.
5. Run: zig build && zig build test
   Both must exit 0.
6. Run: zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set" to ensure no error-set issues.
7. Commit to feature/WF02-dsl02-20260527.
8. Complete handoff with status=COMPLETED, artifacts_out, completed_at from shell.
